profile.headline: Inspiring the world
profile.summary:
I believe that the best engineering doesn't just work - it scales. With over 2 decades in the industry, I have spent my career navigating the transition from consulting and early-stage startup acquisitions to planet-scale infrastructure.

As an engineer who enjoys the full life-cycle of development, I don't just specialize in one stack; I focus on the people and architecture that connect them. My expertise ranges from low-level hardware validation and embedded drivers to high-level Ad Tech and petabyte-scale data pipelines. I specialize in transforming complex, high-traffic systems into high-performance, cost-efficient platforms. I am as comfortable in the kernel as I am in the cloud.

I’m currently passionate about where distributed systems meet AI and hardware integration. If you’re building something complex, high-scale, or just plain interesting, let’s connect!

Systems & Architecture: Distributed Systems, AdTech, High-Throughput Infrastructure, Real-Time Systems

Languages: Go, Rust, Ruby, Java, C/C++, Python, Javascript, Typescript

Infrastructure: Kubernetes, gRPC, MapReduce, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google Cloud

Compliance: GDPR, PCI, HIPAA, CCPA,
